target.title: fix(android): localize chat bubble role labels
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Android chat users could still see the pending tools bubble and live assistant bubble role labels from hard-coded English strings instead of the app's native localization path.

## Why This Change Was Made

The pending tools and streaming assistant bubbles now resolve their role labels through the shared chat `roleLabel()` helper, matching the existing user, system, and assistant bubbles. A focused unit test locks both bubble call sites to the localized helper and verifies the two new role branches stay wired to `nativeString()`.

## User Impact

Android chat role labels are more consistent with the rest of the localized chat UI. Translators and generated Android native string resources can now cover these labels without a special-case hard-coded path.

## Evidence

- `node --import tsx scripts/android-app-i18n.ts check`
- `git diff --check`
- `apps/android: .\gradlew.bat --console=plain --no-daemon "-Dkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process" "-Pkotlin.incremental=false" :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatMessageViewsTest`
- `apps/android: .\gradlew.bat --console=plain --no-daemon :app:ktlintCheck`

`autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` was attempted, but the Codex reviewer subprocess failed before returning structured findings because the Windows helper alias setup refused the temporary PATH helper directory. Retried with a repository-external temp directory and then with `--engine claude`; Claude CLI is not installed locally.
